title: Should I deinterlace every video with yadif?
fullTitle: FFmpeg yadif Changes All 50 Progressive Frames and Wipes One-Pixel Rows

scenes.narration: Should you add dash v f yadif to every video, just in case? On interlaced footage it removes combing. But what does it do to a clip that is already progressive? We measure frames changed, detail kept, and the frame count.
captions: Add yadif to every video, just in case?
We measure frames changed, detail kept, frame count.

scenes.narration: Three synthetic clips, fifty frames each. Fine is progressive, with one pixel stripes, static one pixel lines, and a moving striped box. Smooth is progressive without fine detail. The control is truly interlaced, woven from two moments: adjacent rows differ five point five times as much as rows two apart. Readers: raw luma in Node, frame md5, and the i det filter.
captions: Fine and smooth are progressive. Control is woven.

scenes.narration: Plain yadif on the fine progressive clip: fifty of fifty frames change, by raw luma and by frame md5. In the stripe patch, adjacent rows differed by one hundred eighty; now one point six. P S N R against the source is six point one decibels. The moving striped box falls from thirty eight point five to point one. Static single lines survive.

On the smooth clip yadif still changes fifty of fifty frames, but only fourteen pixels each. With deint equals interlaced, zero of fifty change: the same hashes. But it trusts the flag, not the picture. The same fine pixels, encoded with ilme and ildct, say interlaced, and fifty of fifty change again.
captions: Smooth clip: 14 pixels a frame, 52.7 dB.

scenes.narration: The control proves the readers. On the woven clip, yadif takes combing from five point five to point five, and i det goes from fifty interlaced to fifty progressive. And mode equals one doubles the rate: fifty frames in, one hundred out.
captions: Control: combing 5.5 to 0.5. idet 50 TFF to 50 progressive.

scenes.narration: Do not add yadif to everything. Read the field order with f f probe. I det cannot call the fine clip progressive: fifty undetermined. Use deint equals interlaced only if the flag is honest. Not tested: real footage, other deinterlacers, other builds, players.
captions: Check field_order with ffprobe, count with idet.
Not tested: real footage, other deinterlacers, players.
